supplierPortalContact.emailLaterHint: You can leave out the email and add people later on the customer's Access page. Without an email nothing is sent.
supplierPortalContact.needNameOrEmail: Give the customer's company name or an email address.
supplierPortalContact.contactsEmpty: No one has the link to your security profile yet. Add an email below and they are sent it.
supplierPortalContact.linkSent: The link to your security profile was sent to {email}.
supplierPortalContact.linkNotSent: The link could not be sent to {email}.
supplierPortalContact.removeAccessBody: Their link to your security profile stops working and nothing is sent to this address any more. The customer and the other people stay.
supplierPortalContact.accessRemoved: Access removed. The customer is still in your list.
supplierPortalContact.deleteCustomerBody: The customer is deleted for good, with the systems you recorded for it and the incident notices you sent it. Its link to your security profile stops working. This cannot be undone.
supplierPortalContact.deleteCustomerBodyOwnAccount: This customer has its own account. It leaves your list and its access to your security profile ends, but it keeps its own record of you. This cannot be undone.
supplierPortalContact.ownAccountNote: This customer has its own account and is reached at the address it keeps there.
